topic: Kaido's dragon form looked strongest on paper, but going full dragon was the trap that let Luffy adjust
title: Kaido's Dragon Form Was His Trap, Not His Peak
description: Everyone calls Kaido's dragon form his strongest move. I think it was the trap: the size and scales looked unbeatable, but they made him a bigger target once Luffy started adjusting. The full breakdown is linked above.
comment: Is Kaido's dragon form strongest on paper, or strongest in the actual duel? Pick a side and say why.
pages: Uo Uo no Mi, Model: Seiryu

lines.text: Kaido's dragon form is the move everyone calls his strongest.

shot.fallback: anime style giant azure dragon over a stormy rooftop, no text

lines.text: Fans cite the scales, the size and the fire, and all three are real.

shot.fallback: anime style dragon scales glowing with fire, no text

lines.text: Normal Haki can't get through those scales, so the dragon looks unbeatable.

shot.fallback: anime style armored dragon hide close up, no text

lines.text: But a dragon built for spectacle comes with a cost.

shot.fallback: anime style massive dragon towering over a rooftop, no text

lines.text: Its size made it the biggest target on the rooftop.

shot.fallback: anime style giant dragon and rubber pirate in close combat, no text

lines.text: Kaido had already won several clashes with Luffy when he went full dragon.

shot.fallback: anime style fierce duel on a rooftop at night, no text

lines.text: Winning made him reach for his biggest tool, not his smartest one.

shot.fallback: anime style giant azure dragon over a stormy rooftop, no text

lines.text: Then Luffy came back with Gear 5, and his Conqueror's Haki grew during the fight.

shot.fallback: anime style rubber pirate in Gear 5 glowing white, no text

lines.text: The scales held off normal Haki, but they couldn't stop a moving target.

shot.fallback: anime style fist glowing with white haki aura, no text

lines.text: Fan reporting puts that final rooftop fight in manga chapter 1049.

shot.fallback: anime style rooftop battle at dawn, no text

lines.text: So was the dragon his strongest move, or just the most visible one?

shot.fallback: anime style giant dragon and rubber pirate in close combat, no text

lines.text: My answer: strongest on paper, and the wrong choice for the duel.

shot.fallback: anime style giant azure dragon over a stormy rooftop, no text

lines.text: Calling it his strongest move is exactly how that trap works.

shot.fallback: anime style two fighters facing each other, no text
